import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"project_id\":0,\"item_id\":0,\"comment\":{\"body\":\"string\"}}"

headers = {
    'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN",
    'content-type': "application/json"
    }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/checklist/lists/%7Blist_id%7D/comments", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
